## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all production regions. Notably, its release-candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had already been unhealthy in staging.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history and identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0 — the first attempt partially failed (us-east rolled back, rollout halted on an orchestrator error), so I verified state and retried.
3. Retry succeeded: **all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now run v2.3.0**, confirmed healthy with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. Opened a **SEV2 incident (INC-0001)** documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), current healthy state, and a recommendation to hold v2.3.1 deploys until the root cause is fixed and verified in staging.
